hypothesis: The scratch 3D crop head and frozen-pretrained feature head make complementary daughter-pair ranking errors; a fixed equal percentile-rank average can improve high-precision parent recall without calibration sweeps.
single_candidate: Compute both scores on the exact same K=4 validation pairs, convert each full candidate vector to stable percentile ranks, and average 0.50/0.50. No alternate weight, probability blend or threshold sweep is admitted.
external_gate: On all parents from the 64 external time-validation shards, require proposal recall ceiling at least 0.90, report both parent APs/correlation/ensemble AP, and require ensemble parent precision at least 0.50 with recall at least 0.20.
competition_gate: No competition data unless the external gate passes. If it passes, freeze the ensemble and one rank threshold before reciprocal source scoring; both source directions must be nonnegative and graph/division safety must pass before one prospective 24-movie OOF.
implementation_tests: 7 passed, including exact daughter-swap invariance for both heads and deterministic monotone percentile ranks.
resource: One RTX6000 through the common queue; 8 CPU, 32 GiB RAM, 2 GiB disk, 20 minutes.
